item.title: Research Intern — Institut Pasteur
item.description:
Research Intern / Collaborator

Institut Pasteur | Biological Image Analysis Unit
Paris, France — June 2025 – Present

Project: Shape-Matching Models for Membrane Morphogenesis

Developing computational methods at the intersection of geometric deep learning and biophysics to analyze membrane curvature dynamics.

Key Contributions

  • Shape-Matching Models: Developed novel algorithms incorporating biomechanical constraints (Helfrich energy) to analyze membrane curvature with high precision

  • Computational Framework: Built an optimized pipeline for large-scale molecular simulations, achieving 10× speed-up over legacy implementations

item.title: Research Collaborator — NAIST
item.description:
Research Collaborator

Nara Institute of Science and Technology (NAIST) | CARE Laboratory Japan (Remote) — October 2024 – December 2024

Project: Geometric Deep Learning for 3D Content Generation

Conducted a comprehensive literature survey on state-of-the-art Geometric Deep Learning approaches for generating 3D models in Virtual Reality environments.

Key Contributions

  • Literature Survey: Compiled a structured review of Geometric DL solutions for generating 3D models from multimodal inputs (text, images, point clouds)

item.title: Software Development Intern — Ministry of Equipment & Water
item.description:
Software Development Intern

Ministry of Equipment & Water | Directorate of Technical Affairs
Rabat, Morocco — July 2024 – August 2024

Project: Internal Chatbot for Process Automation

Developed an intelligent chatbot system to automate routine administrative queries and form-filling processes.

Key Contributions

  • Automation Platform: Built an internal chatbot automating queries and form-filling, reducing manual workload by approximately 50%

  • LLM Fine-tuning: Fine-tuned a GPT-4 model specifically for price revision in the context of public works contracts in Morocco
